property_summary: For any caller and any block number, calling settle when no guess was ever locked must revert (because the reference requires guesses[msg.sender].block != 0), whereas the mutant allows such a call to complete and zero out block 0, so the reference's settle call must always revert when the caller has no locked guess.
change_summary: Delete the require(guesses[msg.sender].block != 0) guard, allowing settle to be called when no guess is locked.
